title: 第十七章 香菱落泪观园炫耀第十八章 兵痞拦道一招杀之
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 甄家家道中落，甄士隐又跟了坡足道人。
如今的香菱，除了这偌大的贾府，哪还有第二个家？
贾环这般哄她，也不过是留个念想，好叫她往后的日子也有一个盼头。
却不曾想！
他那话一出，香菱蓦地跪了下去！
“这是干什么，快起来。”
贾环把香菱拉了起来。
香菱眼中噙着泪，嗓音也一度哽咽，“爷的恩情，奴婢此生是还不完了……”
彩霞一手搀着香菱，一手拍了拍她的裤子，笑道：“什么还不还的？爷人好着呢！”
“你别看后院那帮婆子们嚼舌根，她们都是嫉妒爷，所以说爷的坏话，爷一直都很不错。”
彩霞这是带了滤镜。
以前贾环经常出去外面乱来，彩霞也觉得那是因为贾环还没有找到方向。
现在找到方向了，成了神枢营的一员，立即就变的不一样了。
香菱擦了擦眼泪，点了点头：“我相信爷，哪怕就是找不到家人了，我也不会怪爷的，爷对我们好就行了。”
“傻丫鬟！”
贾环无奈的笑了下，道：“我定会帮你找到家人的，放心好了，其他不用想那么多。”
今晚的后院，一副温馨的画面。
大观园中。
赵姨娘又开始了观园一圈游！
不求人人都知道贾环当把总的事，但至少也要让遇到自己的人都知道。
转过两个院子，正巧见到林黛玉从潇湘馆里头走出来。
赵姨娘上前一把就拉住林黛玉。
“林姑娘，哎呀，怎么在这儿遇到你，真是巧啊！”赵姨娘道。
林黛玉微微蹙眉，这是自己院子门口，在这里遇到自己不是很正常的吗？
而且方才她正听宝玉说贾环出了事，提督都来家里抓他了，怎么赵姨娘这会还如此高兴，是不知道吗？
林黛玉心中诧异，却又不好明言，只是掩嘴一笑。
“可不巧嘛，姨娘要再走上几步，都能来我屋里头坐了。”
“姑娘啊，你可知道，环儿现在是把总了！”赵姨娘毫不犹豫的炫耀。
“嗯？”林黛玉稍微一惊，问：“当官了吗？”
“对啊对啊！”
content_en:
The Zhen family was in decline, and Zhen Shiyin followed Taoist Pozu again.
Today, besides the huge Jia Mansion, where else can Xiangling have a second home?
Jia Huan coaxed her like this just to keep her in mind so that she could have something to look forward to in the future.
But I never thought about it!
As soon as he said those words, Xiangling suddenly knelt down!
"What are you doing? Get up quickly."
Jia Huan pulled Xiang Ling up.
There were tears in Xiangling's eyes, and her voice was choked with sobs. "My kindness will never end in this life..."
Caixia held Xiangling in one hand, patted her pants with the other, and said with a smile: "Why don't you pay me back? I'm fine!"
"Don't look at the gossips of those women in the backyard. They are all jealous of me, so they say bad things about me. He has always been very good."
Caixia is wearing a filter.
In the past, Jia Huan often went out and messed around, and Caixia also thought it was because Jia Huan had not found his direction yet.
Now that I have found my direction and become a member of the Shenshu Camp, I will immediately become different.
Xiangling wiped her tears and nodded: "I believe you. Even if you can't find your family, I won't blame you. As long as you are good to us, that's all."
"Silly maid!"
Jia Huan smiled helplessly and said, "I will definitely help you find your family. Don't worry, you don't have to think too much about anything else."
There was a warm scene in the backyard tonight.
…
In the Grand View Garden.
Aunt Zhao started her garden tour again!
You don’t need everyone to know what Jia Huan is doing, but you should at least let everyone who meets you know.
After turning two courtyards, I happened to see Lin Daiyu walking out of Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
Aunt Zhao stepped forward and grabbed Lin Daiyu.
"Miss Lin, oh my, what a coincidence to meet you here!" Aunt Zhao said.
Lin Daiyu frowned slightly. This was the entrance to her yard. Isn't it normal to meet her here?
And just now she heard Baoyu say that something happened to Jia Huan and that the admirals had come to arrest him. Why was Aunt Zhao still so happy now? Did she not know?
Lin Daiyu was surprised, but she couldn't express it clearly, so she just covered her mouth and smiled.
"What a coincidence, my aunt has to walk a few steps before she can come and sit in my room."
"Girl, you know, Huan'er is in charge now!" Aunt Zhao showed off without hesitation.
"Huh?" Lin Daiyu was slightly surprised and asked, "Have you become an official?"
"Yes, yes!"
title_en: Chapter 17: Xiangling sheds tears while watching the garden to show off Chapter 18: Soldiers block the road and kill them with one move
